# uptimeify_im_schedule (Data Source)

Look up one on-call schedule by `id` or by `name` (exactly one). The default schedules of different teams can share a name (`Tier 1 schedule`), so `team_id` narrows a lookup by name. Fails when no or several schedules match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_im_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

# Default schedules of different teams can share a name, team_id narrows the lookup.
data "uptimeify_im_schedule" "first_tier" {
  name    = "Tier 1 schedule"
  team_id = tonumber(data.uptimeify_im_team.platform.id)
}

# Take the first member of the looked-up schedule off call for the holidays.
resource "uptimeify_im_schedule_override" "holiday" {
  schedule_id = data.uptimeify_im_schedule.first_tier.id
  user_id     = data.uptimeify_im_schedule.first_tier.rotations[0].members[0]
  type        = "offline"
  starts_at   = "2030-08-01T00:00:00Z"
  ends_at     = "2030-08-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric schedule id.
- `name` (String)
- `team_id` (Number) Team of the schedule; narrows a lookup by `name`, conflicts with `id`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_rotation_size` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `custom_repeat_unit` (String)
- `custom_repeat_value` (Number)
- `effective_from` (String)
- `effective_until` (String)
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `rotation_mode` (String)
- `rotation_repeats` (String)
- `rotations` (Attributes List) Ordered rotation groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rotations))
- `round_robin_size` (Number)
- `starts_on_date_of_month` (Number)
- `starts_on_day_of_week` (Number)
- `starts_on_time` (String)
- `team_name` (String)
- `tier_id` (Number)
- `timezone` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `weekly_schedules` (Attributes List) Weekly windows; empty = around the clock. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly_schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--rotations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rotations`

Read-Only:

- `members` (List of String) User ids in order.


<a id="nestedatt--weekly_schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `weekly_schedules`

Read-Only:

- `days` (List of Number) ISO weekdays, 1 = Monday to 7 = Sunday.
- `from` (String)
- `until` (String)
